title: Joining Stanford University for an MS in Management Science & Engineering
preview: I'm super excited to share that this fall, I will be joining Stanford University to pursue an MS in Management Science & Engineering.
fullText:
I'm super excited to share that this fall, I will be joining Stanford University to pursue an MS in Management Science & Engineering.

From growing up in Përmet, to studying economics at Dalhousie University, gaining experience at KPMG and TD, as well as founding Albanian Trailblazers, this journey has been challenging and very fulfilling.

I am deeply grateful to the amazing people who have supported me along the way. To my family, my partner, and my mentors: thank you.

Next stop, Palo Alto! 🌲
